editorial.blurb: Sushi Love Avondale delivers expertly crafted nigiri and creative rolls with quality ingredients at honest prices, earning devoted fans across the Phoenix area.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server for a roll recommendation like the staff does—they'll steer you toward the Baja roll or golden vegas roll based on your taste, and the team is genuinely welcoming to sushi newcomers.

topDishes.note: Superior quality and proportion, best in the area
